# External image references

This directory is reserved for **third-party product/listing images** used as comparative evidence in XGO archaeology.

These files are not part of the immutable `images/inbox/` corpus of user-supplied photographs. Every archived retail/listing image should record:

- original source URL and retailer/site;
- retrieval date;
- page/listing identifier when available;
- what is directly visible in the image;
- whether the image is believed to depict the exact XGO A10 specimen or a closely related retail variant;
- copyright/provenance note: image remains the property of its original publisher/rights holder and is archived only as research/reference evidence.

Do not treat marketing text printed into a product image as independent hardware proof. Cross-check against the physical specimen, firmware, PCB evidence, or multiple independent listings.


## Captured external sets (2026-09-07)

- **Exact XGO A10 / AliExpress item 3256811871013165:** 21 source images supplied directly by the owner in the research session. These are exact-model retail evidence and should be archived under `images/external/aliexpress-3256811871013165/` when binary GitHub ingestion is available.
- **XGO DY09 / ChargerLAB teardown:** 3 source images supplied directly by the owner. DY09 is a different 5000mAh product and is comparative Xinguo-family evidence only; it must never be treated as an A10 teardown.

The current research environment has the image bytes and SHA-256 hashes locally, but the GitHub text/content integration used for this update does not provide a practical binary-file transfer path from the local runtime. Do not mark the binary corpus as archived in GitHub until the PNG files themselves appear in the repository.
